summary: Add keyboard accessibility to the before/after comparison slider: tabindex, role, aria attributes, ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End key handling, aria-valuenow updates in setSplit, descriptive alt text updated in show(), and visible focus style in CSS.

replacements.replacement: <div class="cmp" id="cmp" style="--split: 50%" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Before/after comparison" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="50">
const setSplit = (v) => { const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v)); cmp.style.setProperty("--split", `${c}%`); cmp.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", Math.round(c)); };

replacements.search: .cmp .bg-blur { position: absolute; inset: -40px; width: calc(100% + 80px); height: calc(100% + 80px); object-fit: cover; filter: blur(40px) brightness(0.35) saturate(1.2); transform: scale(1.1); }
